_about: Hugh Martin (1822-1885), Free Church of Scotland minister: The Atonement, in its relations to the Covenant, the Priesthood, the Intercession of our Lord (Edinburgh: Lyon and Gemmell, 1877), and The Prophet Jonah, his character and mission to Nineveh (third edition, Edinburgh: Gemmell, 1880); The Westminster Doctrine of the Inspiration of Scripture (fourth edition, London: Nisbet, 1890) and Letters to Marcus Dods (second edition, London: Nisbet, 1877), the last two from lane A's round-11 copy of this shelf, merged 2026-10-03. The Shadow of Calvary survives on IA only in lending-library reprints (1954-1983), which the gate refuses. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
